Self-hosted fonts from Google Fonts.
Tinos: body text, headings and italic cover names.
Libre Bodoni: formal names.
Allura: calendar month and handwritten accents.
Latin, Latin Extended and Vietnamese subsets.
Source CSS: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Tinos:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400;1,700&family=Libre+Bodoni:wght@400&family=Allura&display=swap

Font sources:
https://github.com/googlefonts/tinos
https://github.com/googlefonts/Libre-Bodoni
https://github.com/googlefonts/allura
See the accompanying OFL license files.
